sources.author: Piko
patch_list: Add settings
Adds settings to control preferences are patching
Allow user network certificate
Allows user network certificate for whitehat testing
Change like animation
Change the animation to one from existing Rings like animations
Change version code
Changes the version code of the app. This will turn off app store updates and allows downgrading an existing app install to an older app version.
Clone
Changes the package name and the app name. This allows you to install the patched app alongside the original Instagram app.
Copy comment
Adds buttons to copy comments and their authors' usernames on posts and reels.
Custom font
Adds an option to replace the app font with a font file from the device storage.
Custom sharing domain
Allows for using custom domains when sharing posts, reels and stories.
Customise story ring size
Customise story timestamp
Customise the timestamp that shows when the story was posted
Customize navigation bar
Choose which tabs appear in the bottom navigation bar and reorder them
Disable ads
Disable analytics
Block analytics that are sent to Instagram/Facebook servers.
Disable comments
Disables comments and hides comment buttons on posts, reels and stories
Disable disappearing messages swipe
Prevents swiping up in a chat from enabling disappearing messages
Disable discover people
Hides suggested accounts
Disable double tap like
Disable double tap like on post, reel, comment and message
Disable explore
Disable highlights
Disable Reels scrolling
Disables the endless scrolling behavior in Instagram Reels, preventing swiping to the next Reel. Note: On a clean install, the 'Tip' animation may appear but will stop on its own after a few seconds.
Disable screenshot detection
Disables screenshots detection in DM
Disable stories
Disable story flipping
Disable automatic flipping/moving to next story
Disable swipe to create
Prevents opening the creation screen by swiping right on the home tab.
Disable telemetry
Disables analytics upload components and Falco event logging.
Disable typing status
Disable video autoplay
Download media
Adds ability to download posts, reels, stories and highlights
Download voice message
Enables ability to download voice messages
External downloader
Adds support to share post links directly to external downloader
Filter stories
Filter stories to hide based on different categories
Focus Lock

Commitment mode for cutting down on Instagram. Pick what to block (Reels, Explore) and a duration; once locked those protections are forced on and cannot be switched off. Reels shared with you still open. Unlocking early requires a 24 hour…
Friendship status indicator
Adds a follows you back status label on the profile page and shows a detailed friendship status breakdown on click
Hidden chats
Adds an option to the chat menu that moves the chat to a private inbox, opened by tapping the messages button several times.
Hide feed posts
Hides posts from the home feed
Hide group creation button on sharesheet
Hide hidden requests
Hides the hidden requests (spam) button in the message requests page
Hide like buttons
Hides like buttons on posts, reels and stories
Hide notes tray
Hides notes tray in DM section
Hide Reels follow button
Removes the follow button from Reels.
Hide reshare button
Hides the reshare button from both posts and reels.
Hide save buttons
Hides save buttons on posts and reels
Hide share button
Hides the share button on posts, reels and stories
Hide stories tray
Hides stories tray from main feed.
Hide story follow button
Hides the follow button at the top of stories.
Hide suggested content
Hides suggested stories, reels, threads (Suggested posts will still be shown).
Improve image viewing
Fetches max resolution images from server.
Inbox lock
Asks for your fingerprint, face or screen lock before the inbox is shown.
Limit feed to following profiles
Filters the home feed to display only content from profiles you follow.
Loop story
Replay the current story when it ends
Make ephemeral media permanent
Changes unexpired view once, view twice media to permanent view.
Mark as read after reply
Adds an option to mark chats as read after replying while viewing DMs anonymously.
Mark chat as read manually
Adds option to mark a thread aka message as read manually
More options on post
Adds an overflow menu button to get more options on post/reels, like copy description, copy username etc
More options on profile
Adds a new button to handle user related data like copy handle, download profile picture etc
Open links externally
Changes links to always open in your external browser, instead of the in-app browser.
Recommended flags
Developer flags suggested by the community
Remove empty bottom space
Removes empty space below bottom navigation bar
Resume Reels after scrolling
Resumes videos from where you left off when you scroll back to them in Reels
Sanitize share links
Save deleted messages
Captures incoming DMs locally as they arrive from the server and marks them when the sender deletes them.
Save Instants
Captures view-once Instants as you view them so you can re-view and download them later.
Save media comment
Adds a button to save media comments on posts and reels.
Theme
Adds Material You and AMOLED controls to Piko settings on Android 12 and later. On Android 8–11, it applies a fixed Material You-style theme or an optional AMOLED theme.
Unlock developer options
Unlocks developer option by long pressing home icon
Unlock employee options
Unlocks all options using by employee for debugging
Unlock Plus benefits
Unlocks 'Plus' subscription benefits that are checked locally. USE IT AT YOUR OWN RISK
View DMs anonymously
View live anonymously
View stories anonymously
View story mentions
Add option to view visible and hidden story mentions.

patch_list: Accent color

Swaps Instagram's blue on Follow buttons, links and other highlights for purple, pink, red, orange, green, teal or your wallpaper's colors (Material You, on Android 12 and newer). Restart Instagram to see a change. Starts off. Turn it on i…
Allow screenshots
Lets you take screenshots and record your screen where Instagram normally blocks it, such as disappearing photos and videos in chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.
Ambient light

Puts a soft glow in a post's own colors around its photo or video in Home and Following, and in the bands around a reel that doesn't fill the screen. The glow follows a video as it plays, and you pick how far it spreads and how fast it cha…
App-only proxy
Sends Instagram through an HTTP proxy you set, without changing the proxy for other apps or the phone. You need to set a server too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.
Ask before a call

Asks you to confirm before a call starts from a chat, so a stray tap on the call button doesn't ring anyone, and can take the call buttons off the top of a chat. Both start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Messages.
Ask before a like
Asks you to confirm before the Like button under a post likes or unlikes it, so a stray tap doesn't do it for you. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.
Ask before a refresh
Asks you to confirm before pulling down refreshes Home, Reels or another list, so an accidental pull doesn't replace what you were reading. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.
Back leaves Home
Makes Back on Home leave Instagram at once, instead of first scrolling the feed to the top and reloading it or saying "Tap again to exit". Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.
Blur the bars around Reels
Shows a blurred copy of a reel above and below it, or beside it, where Instagram would leave black bars. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.
Carousel arrows

Puts a back and a next arrow on a post's carousel in Home and Following, so a tap moves to the next photo or video without a swipe, and can move its page dots onto a round pill over the photo. The pill can be solid, see-through or frosted…
Change the like animation
Lets you pick the animation that plays when you double tap a post to like it. The choices are animations Instagram made for its Rings creators. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.
Change version code

Stops Google Play from offering Meta's updates over your patched Instagram. Going back to the normal Instagram later means uninstalling first, which deletes its data. Later HushGram builds need this patch too. Works as soon as you patch it…
Chat history tools

Tap the clock button at the top of a chat, or long press its name, to jump to its first message or to a date, or to save the chat as a text file. The chat loads its older messages on its own, with a count and a Cancel button. Both start of…
Chat plus menu

Lets you take Saved, AI images and Draw off the plus menu in a chat's message bar, and move the gallery and microphone buttons into that menu. Starts with every switch off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Messages.
Clean up Reels

Hides extra buttons and prompts on reels, such as Follow, Edits, templates, Meta AI, Ray-Ban Meta glasses, friends' activity, the Add a comment bar, the reply bar on reels from chats, the Save button, the Create and Your algorithm buttons,…
Clear the media cache

Frees storage by deleting Instagram's saved copies of photos and videos once they pass 500 MB. Your sign-in, drafts and settings stay. A row clears them right away. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Storage.
Control taps and volume on Reels

Lets you choose what a single tap on a reel does: Instagram's default, pause, or mute. Can also keep a reel muted when you press volume up. Both start at Instagram's behavior. Choose them in HushGram settings > Playback.
Copy comment
Adds Copy and Copy username to the menu you get on a comment, so you can copy its text or the commenter's username. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Comments.
Data saver

Saves mobile data by loading smaller photos and starting videos at the lowest quality. It uses Full resolution photos and Default playback quality, so it turns both on. It starts with mobile data only. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram se…
Default playback quality

Plays videos, reels and video stories at the quality you choose, instead of the one Instagram picks as it plays. Nothing changes until you pick a quality. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Playback.
Don't report Blend visits
Stops Instagram from telling a chat that you opened its Blend. Ghost mode, at the top of Ads and privacy, turns it on with the others. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.
Don't report screenshots

Stops Instagram from telling people when you take a screenshot of their disappearing photo or video. Ghost mode, at the top of Ads and privacy, turns it on with the others. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.
Don't save recent searches
Keeps the accounts and tags you open from search out of your Recent list. Searches already in Recent stay until you clear them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Explore.
Don't send reel watch history
Stops Instagram from learning which reels you watched and how far you got. Reels you've already watched may come back. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.
Download any reel

Adds Download to the menu of every reel and saves it without Instagram's watermark. You choose the quality, and best is the default. A separate Download cover switch also saves the reel's cover picture, the largest one the post carries, an…
Download any story

Adds Download to the menu of anyone's story. Videos save at the quality you choose and photos at their largest size, and Download as photo saves a still from a video story. A Download button at the top of a story is a separate switch, off…
Download any video

Adds Download to video posts in your feed, saving the video without Instagram's watermark. Other switches add Download for photos, Download cover, a Details row with the post's time and poster, a download icon beside Save under each post,…
Download voice messages
Adds Save to the menu you get when you hold a voice message in a chat. It saves the recording as an audio file. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Downloads.
Emoji style

Shows every emoji in Google's style instead of your phone's own, or in a free emoji pack (Twemoji, OpenMoji, Blobmoji) or a color emoji font file you pick. The full change shows after you restart Instagram. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGr…
Explore without personalization

Opens Explore on the grid that isn't personalized every time and keeps it from switching back after ten minutes. Instagram only promises that grid in the EU. A second switch hides the EU menu button for it. Both start off. Turn them on in…
Find the reel you came from

Open a creator's profile from a reel, then their Reels tab, and it scrolls to that reel and outlines it for a moment. A photo reel is found in their posts. Stop looking ends the search, and Wait for a tap to find it holds it until you tap…
Font

Lets you pick the font Instagram's text uses: Instagram's own, your phone's, or a .ttf or .otf file. Restart Instagram to see a change. Starts on Instagram's font. Pick one in HushGram settings > Layout.
Full resolution photos

Loads photos in the largest size Instagram sends instead of one picked for your screen. A second switch asks for a larger size on screens under 1440 pixels wide, and a third gets reel covers and grid pictures at full size. Uses more data.…
Full screen Reels and Home

Hides the status bar and the navigation bar while Reels shows, and optionally while Home or your messages do. Swipe in from the edge to bring them back for a moment. Back and the keyboard work as usual. It can also show stories over the wh…
Glass in chats

Gives a chat's top bar frosted glass that blurs the messages under it (Android 12 and newer) and puts the back, call and video buttons on round glass circles. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.
Glass tab bar

Draws the tab bar as a floating, rounded pill of frosted glass that blurs what's behind it (Android 12 and newer), with a highlight on the tab you're on. Content can optionally run down behind it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram setting…
Group Instagram's notifications

Puts Instagram's notifications in one group, or in a group for each type, so they don't fill your notification shade. Tapping one still opens it. You can also mute the types you pick, like promo pushes. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram s…
Hide activity bubbles
Takes the little round pictures off posts and reels that show a friend liked, commented on or reshared them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.
Hide ads
Hides sponsored posts, reels, stories and the ad in comments, and leaves no gap where an ad would have been. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.
Hide AI-labeled reels
Leaves out reels that carry Instagram's own AI label. A reel without that label stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.
Hide captions
Takes the caption off posts in your feed and off reels. The post stays, and the comments sheet still shows it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.
Hide comments
Takes the Comment button and the comment count off posts in your feed. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Comments.
Hide Follow on feed posts
Takes the Follow and Subscribe buttons off the top of posts in your feed. The name, time and menu stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.
Hide Follow on stories
Takes the Follow button off the top of stories from accounts you don't follow. The name, time and menu stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.
Hide GIFs in comments

Takes GIFs and stickers out of comments, and the GIF button off the comment box. A comment with words keeps them. One that's only a GIF goes, along with its replies. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Comments.
Hide group buttons on the share sheet

Takes the New group button and the button that sends to several people as a group off the share sheet, and lets you pick which of the round buttons under the people it shows. You can still start a group from your messages. Both start off.…
Hide highlights
Takes the row of story highlights off profiles, yours and other people's. Bios, counts and posts stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.
Hide Instants
Takes the stack of Instants out of your messages. Instants is Instagram's no-edit camera for sharing quick photos with friends. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.
Hide Meta AI

Removes Meta AI from Instagram's search bars, messages, home top bar, reels menus, share sheet and feed. Each part has its own switch. The search one and the Meta AI posts one start on, the rest start off. Change them in HushGram settings…
Hide Notes on profile pictures
Takes the Notes bubble off profile pictures, yours included. Notes in Messages stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.
Hide paid partnership Reels
Leaves out reels with a Paid partnership label, and reels Instagram marks as boosted. Ads have their own switch. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.
Hide profile tabs
Lets you take the Reels, Reposts and Tagged tabs off profiles, yours and other people's, and keep the grid. Starts with every tab showing. Pick which to hide in HushGram settings > Profiles.
Hide reels by caption words

Leaves out reels whose caption holds a word or phrase from your list, or is in a language you don't keep, and Home's posts too with Also on Home. Starts off. Turn it on and type the words or languages in HushGram settings > Reels.
Hide Reels in the feed
Removes the rows of suggested reels from your home feed. A reel posted by someone you follow stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.
Hide reels with few views
Leaves out reels in the Reels tab with fewer views or likes than numbers you pick. Accounts you follow stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.
Hide rows in Instagram's settings

Lets you take the rows you don't use off Instagram's own Settings and activity screen. Open that screen once, then untick rows in HushGram settings > Layout > Rows in Instagram's settings. Every row shows to start.
Hide suggested accounts in DMs
Takes the Accounts to follow section off the bottom of your messages. Your chats and follow requests stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.
Hide suggested accounts in Reels
Leaves out the cards of accounts to follow that Instagram puts between reels. Every reel still plays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.
Hide suggested people on profiles

Takes Suggested for you and the Discover people button off profiles. Bios, counts and posts stay. More switches take Suggested for you off the follow lists, their Suggested tab and the Follow requests screen, the Complete your profile card…
Hide suggested posts

Removes posts from accounts you don't follow, suggested accounts, surveys and shopping rows from Home. It also takes shop tiles out of Explore and the shopping bag off posts with tagged products. Posts from accounts you follow stay. Extra…
Hide suggested stories

Removes stories from accounts you don't follow from the row at the top of Home. More switches hide rewinds and memories, keep only verified or unverified accounts, or hide the whole row. Starts on. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Storie…
Hide that you're typing

Stops the people you're chatting with from seeing when you're typing. You still see when they type. Ghost mode, at the top of Ads and privacy, turns it on with the others. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.
Hide the audio icon on posts
Takes the speaker icon off videos in your feed. Tapping the video still turns the sound on or off. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.
Hide the comment emoji row
Takes the row of quick emoji off above the comment box. The box itself stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Comments.
Hide the Explore grid

Empties the grid of posts and reels on the Search tab. Search, recent searches and results stay. A second switch hides the suggested accounts that show when you tap the search bar. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Explore.
Hide the home feed
Empties your home feed on purpose, so Home shows only the stories row. Profiles, Explore and Reels still show posts. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.
Hide the notes row

Takes the row of notes, and the Map bubble in it, off the top of your messages. Your chats stay. A second switch takes only the Map bubble. Both start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Messages.
Hide the Reels tab

Takes the Reels tab off the tab bar. Reels in your feed and reels people send you still open. A second switch, Show the Reels tab, puts it back after Home when Instagram built your bar without one, and Hide wins if both are on. Restart Ins…
Hide the reply box on stories
Takes the Send message box off the bottom of other people's stories. The like and share buttons next to it stay where they are. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.
Hide the Repost button
Takes the Repost button and its count off posts and reels, so nothing gets reposted by mistake. Share still works. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Sharing.
Hide the search bar in Messages
Takes the search bar and its Filter button off the top of your messages, the Meta AI bar too. Your chats and notes stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.
Hide the Share button
Takes the Share button and its count off posts in your feed and off reels. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Sharing.
Hide the Threads button

Takes the Threads button off the top of profiles, with switches for the Create button and Share profile on your own, and Subscribe and the arrow after the buttons on creators' profiles. The menu and the other buttons stay. Each starts off.…
Hide your active status

Stops people from seeing Active now for you while you use Instagram. You still see when they're active. Ghost mode, at the top of Ads and privacy, turns it on with the others. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.
Home header text
Puts words of your own, or a picture, at the top of Home in place of Instagram's logo. Nothing changes until you set one in HushGram settings > Layout.
HushGram launch screen
Shows HushGram's logo instead of Instagram's on the screen you see while Instagram starts, on Android 13 and newer. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Layout.
HushGram settings

Adds a HushGram settings page to Instagram. Open it by long-pressing the Instagram logo at the top of your feed or Instagram's icon, or from the top of Settings and activity. Turn features on or off there, pause HushGram and save diagnosti…
Install next to Instagram

Installs this build as a second Instagram beside your normal one, with its own data and sign-in. Pick its package name and app name in the patch's options, and whether its icon gets a HushGram badge. Works as soon as you patch it in, with…
Jump a profile's posts to a date

Puts a calendar on a profile's top bar. Pick a day and the posts grid goes back to that day, with older posts as you scroll. Pull down for the newest again. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.
Keep a seek bar on Reels
Keeps a seek bar under every reel, short ones too, with the time played and the reel's length above it, like 0:10 / 0:55. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.
Keep Home's top bar
Keeps the Instagram logo and the buttons beside it at the top of Home while you scroll. A second switch shows your feed blurred under them. Both start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Feed.
Keep in chat

Keeps view once and replayable photos and videos in your chats after you open them, so they don't disappear. A photo or video you send stays Instagram's own sent bubble. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.
Keep playing in the background
A video or reel playing with sound keeps going when you leave Instagram or turn the screen off, with a notification to pause or stop it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Playback.
Keep Reels auto scroll on

Keeps Instagram's auto scroll in Reels turned on after you leave Reels or restart Instagram, until you turn it off yourself. It can also move on to the next reel when one ends on accounts where Instagram doesn't offer auto scroll. Starts o…
Keep stories playing while zooming
Keeps a story playing while you pinch to zoom it, instead of pausing it. A story you hold still first stays paused. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.
Keep the reel speed
Keeps the 2x speed on for the next reels after you lock a reel at 2x (hold its edge, then slide down), until you slide the lock off. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Reels.
Keep the Reels top bar
Keeps the Reels title, the Friends tab and the buttons beside them at the top while you swipe through reels. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.
Keep your place in Home
Coming back to Instagram leaves Home on the post you were on, however long you were away, instead of reloading it and jumping to the top. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.
Lock your messages

Covers your inbox and chats, all of Instagram, or just the single chats you pick under Locked chats, until your fingerprint, face or screen lock says it's you. Message notifications only say that a message came. Chats you pick under Hidden…
Long press to zoom

Press and hold a photo in a feed to see it twice as big around your finger, and let go to close it. Pinch to zoom still works. Keep the zoom open leaves it up after you let go, to drag and pinch from 1x to 4x until a tap or Back closes it.…
Loop a story
Plays a story again from the start when it ends, instead of moving on to the next one. Tap or swipe to move on. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.
Mark one-time photos and videos

Puts a border and Instagram's own view once icon on a one-time photo or video in a chat, so you can tell it before you open it. Only how the chat looks changes. Nothing is saved, replayed, marked seen or sent. Starts off. Turn it on in Hus…
Message box buttons

Lets you take the gallery, sticker and voice message buttons off the message box of a chat, and keep the text box and Send. Starts with every button showing. Pick which to hide in HushGram settings > Messages.
Open comments without the keyboard
Comments open with the keyboard down. A tap in the comment box, or on Reply, still brings it up. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Comments.
Open links in external browser

Opens web links you tap in your usual browser instead of Instagram's built-in one, without Instagram's click tracker. Ads and Meta's own sites (Instagram, Facebook, Messenger, Threads) still open in the app. On by default. Turn it off in H…
Phone layout on big screens

On a foldable or tablet, Instagram keeps its phone layout across the whole screen, with the tab bar at the bottom instead of down the side. Restart Instagram to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Layout.
Pick the app icon

Lets you pick the icon Instagram shows on your home screen: Instagram's own, HushGram's, Instagram's glyph on black, on plum, or in black on white, a hand-drawn Instagram glyph on white, Instagram's gradient glyph on dark, the old retro ca…
Pinch to zoom on Reels

Lets you zoom into a playing reel with two fingers, the way a photo zooms. Lift your fingers and it goes back. Restart Instagram to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.
Preview chats

Long press a chat in your messages and tap Preview to read its newest messages without opening it, so nobody sees Seen. You can reply from there too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.
Profile posts as a list
Opening someone's profile takes you on to their posts as a scrolling list of full posts. Back shows the grid. Your own profile keeps its grid. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.
Pure black dark mode

Makes Instagram's dark mode pure black instead of dark gray, on the menus that slide up from the bottom too. It looks deeper and can save battery on an OLED screen. Buttons keep their grays so they stay easy to see. Works as soon as you pa…
Read messages without the seen receipt

Opening a chat no longer tells people you've seen their messages. You still see when they've seen yours. Mark as read, or the check mark at the top of a chat, still tells them. With `Choose Seen in each chat` on, an eye at the top of each…
Remove build expired popup

Stops Instagram from locking you out with a screen that says this version is too old. A patched build can't update itself, so it would stop working after a few weeks. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Version warnings.
Remove the advertising ID

Stops Instagram from reading your phone's advertising ID, which ad companies use to follow you between apps. Instagram gets a string of zeros instead. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
Remove the empty space at the bottom
Takes away the empty gap Instagram leaves under its tab bar for a navigation bar that isn't there. Restart Instagram to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Layout.
Restore trust on re-signed builds

Lets Instagram's own checks of who signed the app pass on a patched build, so the parts that need them keep working. Threads, Facebook and Messenger patched with the same key work too. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
Resume long videos

A video or reel longer than two minutes picks up where you left off the next time you play it on the same account. Live videos and ads start as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Playback.
Rounded post corners

Rounds the corners of a post's photo, video and carousel pages in Home and Following, and of reels and stories if you like, at a small or large size. Profiles and Explore stay as Instagram draws them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram set…
Sanitize sharing links

Removes tracking tags from the links you copy or share, and opens bio links without Instagram's click tracker. The link still opens the same post, reel, story or profile. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.
Save comment photo

Adds Save to the menu on a comment that has its own photo or GIF, saving the largest size Instagram sent. A GIF is saved as a .gif in Pictures/Instagram, taken from Instagram's own copy, not Giphy. If Instagram lists only an animated WebP…
Save profile picture

Adds Save profile picture, View profile picture, Copy username and Copy bio to the menu on someone's profile. View opens the picture full screen and lets you zoom. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Downloads.
Saved on your profile
Adds a bookmark to the tabs on your own profile, beside posts, reels and tagged, that opens Saved. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles, then restart Instagram.
See who a story mentions
Adds a small label in a story's header showing how many accounts it mentions. Tap it for a list and tap an account to open their profile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.
Seek bar on feed videos

Shows a bar along the bottom of the video playing in your feed that you can drag to jump to any point in it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed. Another switch there adds a small button on the video that shows or hides the…

Makes Back on Home leave Instagram at once, instead of first scrolling the feed to the top and reloading it. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Feed.
Blur the bars around Reels
Shows a blurred copy of a reel above and below it, or beside it, where Instagram would leave black bars. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Reels.
Change the like animation
Lets you pick the animation that plays when you double tap a post to like it. The choices are animations Instagram made for its Rings creators. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Reels.
Change version code

Stops Google Play from offering Meta's updates over your patched Instagram. Going back to the normal Instagram later means uninstalling first, which deletes its data. Later TADa builds need this patch too. Works as soon as you patch it in,…
Clean up Reels

Hides extra buttons and prompts on reels, such as Follow, Edits, templates, Meta AI, Ray-Ban Meta glasses, friends' activity, the Add a comment bar, the reply bar on reels from chats, the Save button, the Create and Your algorithm buttons…
Clear the media cache

Frees storage by deleting Instagram's saved copies of photos and videos once they pass 500 MB. Your sign-in, drafts and settings stay. A row clears them right away. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Storage.
Control taps and volume on Reels

Lets you choose what a single tap on a reel does: Instagram's default, pause, or mute. Can also keep a reel muted when you press volume up. Both start at Instagram's behavior. Choose them in TADa settings > Playback.
Copy comment
Adds Copy and Copy username to the menu you get on a comment, so you can copy its text or the commenter's username. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Comments.
Custom branding name for Instagram
Changes the Instagram app name to TADa Instagram (or a custom name specified in patch options).
Data saver

Saves mobile data by loading smaller photos and starting videos at the lowest quality. It uses Full resolution photos and Default playback quality, so it turns both on. It starts with mobile data only. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settin…
Default playback quality

Plays videos, reels and video stories at the quality you choose, instead of the one Instagram picks as it plays. Nothing changes until you pick a quality. On by default. Turn it off in TADa settings > Playback.
Don't report screenshots

Stops Instagram from telling people when you take a screenshot of their disappearing photo or video. Ghost mode, at the top of Ads and privacy, turns it on with the others. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Messages.
Don't save recent searches
Keeps the accounts and tags you open from search out of your Recent list. Searches already in Recent stay until you clear them. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Explore.
Don't send reel watch history
Stops Instagram from learning which reels you watched and how far you got. Reels you've already watched may come back. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Reels.
Download any reel

Adds Download to the menu of every reel and saves it without Instagram's watermark. You choose the quality, and best is the default. A separate Download cover switch also saves the reel's cover picture, the largest one the post carries, an…
Download any story

Adds Download to the menu of anyone's story. Videos save at the quality you choose and photos at their largest size, and Download as photo saves a still from a video story. On by default. Turn it off in TADa settings > Stories.
Download any video

Adds Download to video posts in your feed, saving the video without Instagram's watermark. Other switches add Download for photos, Download cover, a Details row with the post's time and poster, a download icon beside Save under each post,…
Download voice messages
Adds Save to the menu you get when you hold a voice message in a chat. It saves the recording as an audio file. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Downloads.
Emoji style
Shows every emoji in Google's style instead of your phone's own. The full change shows after you restart Instagram. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Layout.
Find the reel you came from

Open a creator's profile from a reel, then their Reels tab, and it scrolls to that reel and outlines it for a moment. A photo reel is found in their posts. Stop looking ends the search, and Wait for a tap to find it holds it until you tap…
Font
Lets you pick the font Instagram's text uses: Instagram's own, your phone's, or a .ttf or .otf file. Restart Instagram to see a change. Starts on Instagram's font. Pick one in TADa settings > Layout.
Full resolution photos

Loads photos in the largest size Instagram sends instead of one picked for your screen. A second switch asks for a larger size on screens under 1440 pixels wide. Uses more data. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Feed.
Full screen Reels and Home

Hides the status bar and the navigation bar while Reels shows, and optionally while Home does. Swipe in from the edge to bring them back for a moment. Back and the keyboard work as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Reels (Fu…
Glass tab bar

Draws the tab bar as a floating, rounded pill of frosted glass that blurs what's behind it (Android 12 and newer), with a highlight on the tab you're on. Content can optionally run down behind it. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings >…
Group Instagram's notifications

Puts Instagram's notifications in one group, or in a group for each type, so they don't fill your notification shade. Tapping one still opens it. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Notifications.
Hide ads
Hides sponsored posts, reels and stories, and leaves no gap where an ad would have been. On by default. Turn it off in TADa settings > Ads and privacy.
Hide AI-labeled reels
Leaves out reels that carry Instagram's own AI label. A reel without that label stays. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Reels.
Hide comments
Takes the Comment button and the comment count off posts in your feed. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Comments.
Hide Follow on feed posts
Takes the Follow and Subscribe buttons off the top of posts in your feed. The name, time and menu stay. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Feed.
Hide Follow on stories
Takes the Follow button off the top of stories from accounts you don't follow. The name, time and menu stay. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Stories.
Hide group buttons on the share sheet

Takes the New group button and the button that sends to several people as a group off the share sheet, and lets you pick which of the round buttons under the people it shows. You can still start a group from your messages. Both start off.…
Hide highlights
Takes the row of story highlights off profiles, yours and other people's. Bios, counts and posts stay. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Profiles.
Hide Instants
Takes the stack of Instants out of your messages. Instants is Instagram's no-edit camera for sharing quick photos with friends. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Messages.
Hide Meta AI

Removes Meta AI from Instagram's search bars, messages, home top bar, reels menus, share sheet and feed. Each part has its own switch. The search one and the Meta AI posts one start on, the rest start off. Change them in TADa settings > Me…
Hide Notes on profile pictures
Takes the Notes bubble off profile pictures, yours included. Notes in Messages stay. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Profiles.
Hide paid partnership Reels
Leaves out reels with a Paid partnership label, and reels Instagram marks as boosted. Ads have their own switch. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Reels.
Hide profile tabs
Lets you take the Reels, Reposts and Tagged tabs off profiles, yours and other people's, and keep the grid. Starts with every tab showing. Pick which to hide in TADa settings > Profiles.
Hide reels by caption words
Leaves out reels whose caption holds a word or phrase from your list, and Home's posts too with Also on Home. Starts off. Turn it on and type the words in TADa settings > Reels.
Hide Reels in the feed
Removes the rows of suggested reels from your home feed. A reel posted by someone you follow stays. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Reels.
Hide suggested accounts in DMs
Takes the Accounts to follow section off the bottom of your messages. Your chats and follow requests stay. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Messages.
Hide suggested accounts in Reels
Leaves out the cards of accounts to follow that Instagram puts between reels. Every reel still plays. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Reels.
Hide suggested people on profiles

Takes Suggested for you and the Discover people button off profiles. Bios, counts and posts stay. More switches take Suggested for you off the followers and following lists, the Complete your profile cards off your own profile, and People…
Hide suggested posts

Removes posts from accounts you don't follow, suggested accounts, surveys and shopping rows from Home. It also takes shop tiles out of Explore and the shopping bag off posts with tagged products. Posts from accounts you follow stay. Extra…
Hide suggested stories
Removes stories from accounts you don't follow from the row at the top of Home. More switches hide rewinds and memories, or the whole row. Starts on. Turn it off in TADa settings > Stories.
Hide that you're typing

Stops the people you're chatting with from seeing when you're typing. You still see when they type. Ghost mode, at the top of Ads and privacy, turns it on with the others. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Messages.
Hide the comment emoji row
Takes the row of quick emoji off above the comment box. The box itself stays. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Comments.
Hide the Explore grid

Empties the grid of posts and reels on the Search tab. Search, recent searches and results stay. A second switch hides the suggested accounts that show when you tap the search bar. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Explore.
Hide the home feed
Empties your home feed on purpose, so Home shows only the stories row. Profiles, Explore and Reels still show posts. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Feed.
Hide the notes row
Takes the row of notes, and the Map bubble in it, off the top of your messages. Your chats stay. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Messages.
Hide the Reels tab

Takes the Reels tab off the tab bar. Reels in your feed and reels people send you still open. A second switch, Show the Reels tab, puts it back after Home when Instagram built your bar without one, and Hide wins if both are on. Restart Ins…
Hide the Repost button
Takes the Repost button and its count off posts and reels, so nothing gets reposted by mistake. Share still works. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Sharing.
Hide the search bar in Messages
Takes the search bar and its Filter button off the top of your messages, the Meta AI bar too. Your chats and notes stay. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Messages.
Hide the Share button
Takes the Share button and its count off posts in your feed and off reels. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Sharing.
Hide the Threads button

Takes the Threads button off the top of profiles, with switches for the Create button and Share profile on your own. The menu and the other buttons stay. Each starts off. Turn them on in TADa settings > Profiles.
Hide your active status

Stops people from seeing Active now for you while you use Instagram. You still see when they're active. Ghost mode, at the top of Ads and privacy, turns it on with the others. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Messages.
Install next to Instagram

Installs this build as a second Instagram beside your normal one, with its own data and sign-in. Pick its package name and app name in the patch's options, and whether its icon gets a TADa badge. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no s…
Keep a seek bar on Reels
Keeps a seek bar under every reel, short ones too, with the time played and the reel's length above it, like 0:10 / 0:55. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Reels.
Keep in chat

Keeps view once and replayable photos and videos in your chats after you open them, so they don't disappear. A photo or video you send stays Instagram's own sent bubble. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Messages.
Keep Reels auto scroll on

Keeps Instagram's auto scroll in Reels turned on after you leave Reels or restart Instagram, until you turn it off yourself. It can also move on to the next reel when one ends on accounts where Instagram doesn't offer auto scroll. Starts o…
Keep the reel speed
Keeps the 2x speed on for the next reels after you lock a reel at 2x (hold its edge, then slide down), until you slide the lock off. On by default. Turn it off in TADa settings > Reels.
Lock your messages

Covers your inbox and chats, all of Instagram, or just the single chats you pick under Locked chats, until your fingerprint, face or screen lock says it's you. Message notifications only say that a message came. Chats you pick under Hidden…
Long press to zoom

Press and hold a photo in a feed to see it twice as big around your finger, and let go to close it. Pinch to zoom still works. Keep the zoom open leaves it up after you let go, to drag and pinch from 1x to 4x until a tap or Back closes it.…
Loop a story
Plays a story again from the start when it ends, instead of moving on to the next one. Tap or swipe to move on. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Stories.
Message box buttons

Lets you take the gallery, sticker and voice message buttons off the message box of a chat, and keep the text box and Send. Starts with every button showing. Pick which to hide in TADa settings > Messages.
Open comments without the keyboard
Comments open with the keyboard down. A tap in the comment box, or on Reply, still brings it up. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Comments.
Open links in external browser

Opens web links you tap in your usual browser instead of Instagram's built-in one, without Instagram's click tracker. Instagram pages and ads still open in the app. On by default. Turn it off in TADa settings > Ads and privacy.
Profile posts as a list
Opening someone's profile takes you on to their posts as a scrolling list of full posts. Back shows the grid. Your own profile keeps its grid. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Profiles.
Pure black dark mode

Makes Instagram's dark mode pure black instead of dark gray, on the menus that slide up from the bottom too. It looks deeper and can save battery on an OLED screen. Buttons keep their grays so they stay easy to see. Works as soon as you pa…
Read messages without the seen receipt

Opening a chat no longer tells people you've seen their messages. You still see when they've seen yours. Mark as read still tells them. Ghost mode turns it on too. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Messages.
Remove build expired popup

Stops Instagram from locking you out with a screen that says this version is too old. A patched build can't update itself, so it would stop working after a few weeks. On by default. Turn it off in TADa settings > Updates.
Remove the advertising ID

Stops Instagram from reading your phone's advertising ID, which ad companies use to follow you between apps. Instagram gets a string of zeros instead. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
Remove the empty space at the bottom
Takes away the empty gap Instagram leaves under its tab bar for a navigation bar that isn't there. Restart Instagram to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Layout.
Restore trust on re-signed builds

Lets Instagram's own checks of who signed the app pass on a patched build, so the parts that need them keep working. Threads, Facebook and Messenger patched with the same key work too. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
Resume long videos

A video or reel longer than two minutes picks up where you left off the next time you play it on the same account. Live videos and ads start as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Playback.
Rounded post corners

Rounds the corners of a post's photo, video and carousel pages in Home and Following, at a small or large size. Stories, profiles, Explore and Reels stay as Instagram draws them. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Feed.
Sanitize sharing links

Removes tracking tags from the links you copy or share, and opens bio links without Instagram's click tracker. The link still opens the same post, reel, story or profile. On by default. Turn it off in TADa settings > Ads and privacy.
Save comment photo

Adds Save to the menu on a comment that has its own photo or GIF, saving the largest size Instagram sent. A GIF is saved as a .gif in Pictures/Instagram, taken from Instagram's own copy, not Giphy. If Instagram lists only an animated WebP…
Save profile picture

Adds Save profile picture, View profile picture, Copy username and Copy bio to the menu on someone's profile. View opens the picture full screen and lets you zoom. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Downloads.
Saved on your profile
Adds a bookmark to the tabs on your own profile, beside posts, reels and tagged, that opens Saved. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Profiles, then restart Instagram.
See who a story mentions
Adds a small label in a story's header showing how many accounts it mentions. Tap it for a list and tap an account to open their profile. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Stories.
Show a post's exact time
Shows the date and time a post went up, like Oct 2, 3:45 PM, instead of how long ago. It does the same for comments. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Feed.
Show a reel's exact time

Adds the date and time a reel was posted under the author's name, like Oct 2, 3:45 PM, with the seconds or how long ago (1d 2h 5m ago) if you want them. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Reels.
Show a story's exact time
Shows the date and time a story was posted, like Oct 2, 3:45 PM, instead of how long ago. A choice under the switch can show the time left instead. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Stories.
Show all recent searches
Lists every recent search under the search bar instead of the first few. See all and the x on each row work as before. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Explore.
Show hidden like counts

Shows how many likes a post or reel has when its owner hid the count, as long as Instagram's server still sends the number. If it doesn't, nothing changes. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Feed.
Show if a profile follows you

Adds Follows you or Doesn't follow you beside the name on someone's profile. Other switches add a chip and mark accounts on your Following list that don't follow you back, and Recent unfollowers shows who left your Followers list. The chip…
Show when someone was last active
Shows the exact time someone was last on, like Active at 3:42 PM, in your messages and in a chat, instead of Active 3h ago. Active now stays. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Messages.
Spoof location

Tells Instagram your phone is at a place you pick, for the location sticker, nearby places and maps. Photos keep their own places. You need to pick a place too. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Ads and privacy.
Start feed videos with sound
Starts the first video on Home with its sound on, the same as tapping the video's speaker. Your phone's ringer and volume still count. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Feed.
Start Home on Following

Opens Home on posts from accounts you follow instead of For you. A second switch removes For you from Home, and a third keeps Instagram's logo at the top of Home in place of the feed's name. Restart Instagram to see the change. Starts off.…
Start on x86 devices

Stops Instagram from crashing or freezing on x86 devices that run its code through a translator, such as some Chromebooks and emulators. Phones and tablets with arm chips run it as before. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
Start stories with sound
Opens stories with their sound on, the same as tapping Instagram's speaker. Your phone's ringer and volume still count. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Stories.
Stop background wake-ups

Stops two alarms that wake your phone while Instagram is in the background. One goes off every minute or two only to note that Instagram is still running, and the other wakes it five minutes later to upload usage events. Messages and notif…
Stop Reels scrolling

Stops a swipe in Reels from moving to the next reel, so you stay on the one you opened. A second switch lets you watch 20 reels, then stops swiping for 15 minutes. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Reels.
Stop Story auto-advance
Keeps each story on screen until you tap or swipe. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Stories.
Stop swipe to create
Stops a sideways swipe on Home from opening the camera. The + button still opens it. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Feed.
Stop swipe up to reply
Stops a swipe up on someone's story from opening the reply box and its reactions. Tapping Send message still replies. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Stories.
Stop swiping between tabs
Stops a sideways swipe from moving between Home, Reels and the other main tabs. Tapping the tab bar still works. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Feed.
Story ring size

Draws the rings in the stories row at the top of Home smaller, so more fit on screen, or larger, and the ring of a story you haven't watched in a color you pick. Nothing changes until you pick a size or a color. On by default. Turn it off…
Swipe left to open the profile

Makes a left swipe on a reel open the profile of the person who posted it, like Instagram used to. Tap Friends at the top to reach your friends' reels. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Reels.
TADa launch screen
Shows TADa's logo instead of Instagram's on the screen you see while Instagram starts, on Android 13 and newer. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Layout.
TADa settings

Adds a TADa settings page to Instagram. Open it by long-pressing the Instagram logo at the top of your feed or Instagram's icon, or from the top of Settings and activity. Turn features on or off there, pause TADa and save diagnostics. Work…
Tap a feed video to pause it
A tap on the video playing in a feed pauses it in place instead of opening it in Reels, and another tap plays it again. Ads keep Instagram's own tap. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Feed.
Tap to play

Makes videos, reels and stories wait for your tap instead of starting by themselves, like Instagram does when it saves mobile data. A choice under the switch can leave Reels out or hold only Reels. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings >…
Turn off double tap to like

Stops a double tap on a post or reel from liking it, and the heart doesn't show. The Like button still works. Separate switches cover posts, reels, comments and chat messages. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Reels.
Turn off HDR brightness boosts
Stops HDR photos and reels from making the screen brighter than everything else. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Playback.
Upload stories at full quality
Sends the video stories you post at up to 1080 pixels wide instead of 720, as Instagram does with its own Upload at highest quality setting on. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Stories.
Use the system photo picker

Adds an entry to Instagram's gallery sheet that opens Android's own photo picker when you make a post, so you pick from your photos and any cloud gallery and Instagram only gets what you choose. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Ad…
View DM photos and videos anonymously

Holds back the Opened notice for view once photos and videos in messages, so the sender doesn't see you opened them. Ghost mode turns it on too. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Ads and privacy.
View live anonymously

Keeps you off the viewer list of the lives you watch, so the host isn't told you're there. Your own lives still count their viewers. Ghost mode turns it on too. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Stories.
View stories anonymously

Keeps you off the viewer list of the stories you watch. Replying or reacting still shows you. An optional Mark as seen button lets you choose. Ghost mode turns it on too. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Stories.

patch_list: Bypass signature check
Stops Instagram rejecting apps by their signature, which a patched app no longer matches.
Disable Reels
Removes reels from the home feed and Explore, and stops scrolling from one reel to the next. Each part is off until you switch it on in the settings.
Hide ads
Removes sponsored posts, stories and reels, and ad units in the home feed. Each part can be switched off in the settings.
Hide navigation buttons
Adds settings to hide Search, Reels, Create, Messages and other tabs from the bottom bar.
Liquid Glass navigation bar

Turns the bottom tab bar into a floating iOS 26 style Liquid Glass pill with live background blur and edge refraction. Refraction needs Android 13+, blur needs Android 12+, older versions get a tinted pill.
Remove build expired popup
Removes the popup that appears after a while, when the app version ages.
View profile picture
Adds a button on the profile picture of profile pages that shows the profile picture in full resolution and saves it to the gallery.
